sentences.text: Doug Jones -LRB- born May 24 , 1960 -RRB- is an American actor and former contortionist known for roles in the science fiction , fantasy , and horror genres , often wearing heavy makeup to play nonhuman characters .	science fiction	science fiction	fantasy	fantasy	horror	Horror fiction

He is perhaps best known for his collaborations with filmmaker Guillermo del Toro , starring in Mimic , as Abe Sapien in Hellboy and Hellboy II : The Golden Army , the Faun and the Pale Man in Pan 's Labyrinth , Crimson Peak and The Shape of Water .	Guillermo del Toro	Guillermo del Toro	Mimic	Mimic (film)	Abe Sapien	Abe Sapien	Hellboy	Hellboy (film)	Crimson Peak	Crimson Peak	The Shape of Water	The Shape of Water (film)
He has appeared in films such as Tank Girl , Hocus Pocus and The Bye Bye Man .	Tank Girl	Tank Girl (film)	Hocus Pocus	Hocus Pocus (1993 film)	The Bye Bye Man	The Bye Bye Man

He also portrayed the titular Silver Surfer in the superhero film Fantastic Four : Rise of the Silver Surfer , as well as appearing in the TV series Falling Skies , Buffy the Vampire Slayer and del Toro 's The Strain .	Silver Surfer	Silver Surfer	Falling Skies	Falling Skies	Buffy the Vampire Slayer	Buffy the Vampire Slayer	The Strain	The Strain (TV series)
He is currently a series regular in Star Trek : Discovery , as Lt. Saru .
